experiment.claim: Issue #26 -- follow-up to issue #4's sim/mos-matching-characterization/, run once #8 (PR #40) fixed the core's actual mirror device sizes/node currents. Sweeps the BSIM operating point (Id, Vth, Vov=Vgs-Vth, gm/Id) of diode-connected sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 and sky130_fd_pr__pfet_g5v0d10v5 at the schematic's actual mirror size (B: W=8/L=2, 16um^2) plus three larger sizes holding the same W/L=4 aspect ratio (C: W=12/L=3, 36um^2; D: W=16/L=4, 64um^2; E: W=20/L=5, 100um^2), all biased at the single ~5.3uA per-unit node current design/bandgap_core.sch's self-biased mirror chain (MPOUT/MPAMP, both W=8/L=2 mult=2) actually converges on -- not the original experiment's generic 2/5/20uA matrix. Combined with the PDK's static Vth-mismatch (AVT) coefficients (sw_mm_vth0_sky130_fd_pr__nfet_g5v0d10v5 / __pfet_g5v0d10v5 in continuous/models_global.spice), this extends the analytic dId/Id-vs-area mismatch projection (dId/Id ~= (gm/Id)*sigma_Vth) to locate where it crosses below 1% for the leg(s) that need it. Supply axis intentionally fixed at nominal 3.30V: all devices are diode-connected and biased by ideal DC current sources with no supply-referenced terminal in the DUT.
experiment.statistical_convention: N/A for the corner-matrix operating-point sweep above (deterministic, MC_MM_SWITCH=0). The dId/Id mismatch figure reported in the summary record is an analytic Pelgrom-style projection from the PDK's static AVT coefficient, not a simulated Monte Carlo distribution -- see design/device-characterization-summary.md Sec 3 for the method and its limitations (only Vth mismatch is modeled by the PDK for this device family).
experiment.title: MOS mirror sizing extension beyond size B (16 um^2) at actual bandgap_core node current (issue #26)
